Studio / About Calquors

A small studio
with broad output.

Calquors is a product studio based in India. We're builders, not consultants — every engagement ends with software in production. Alongside client work we build and run our own products: OmegleVC, Klyq, Revfit and Rivelo Labs. The legal entity is Calquors Private Limited.

Manifesto

01 We build. We don't write strategy decks.

02 Every sprint ends with something a user can touch.

03 Designers write code. Engineers care about pixels.

04 Small teams ship. Big teams meet.

05 We say no to a lot, so we can say yes well.
